description: This file is a PHP test script for the Tree class in the TestLink project. It loads the Tree class, executes various methods such as getNodeByAttributes, get_available_node_types, get_node_hierarchy_info, get_subtree, get_subtree_list, and get_path, and outputs the results for testing purposes.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: The Tree class used for managing hierarchical nodes within the TestLink system.

methods.name: getNodeByAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves a node based on specified attributes such as type and name.

methods.name: get_available_node_types
methods.description: Returns a list of all available node types in the tree.

methods.name: get_node_hierarchy_info
methods.description: Provides hierarchical information about a specific node.

methods.name: get_subtree
methods.description: Retrieves a subtree rooted at a specified node, with options to exclude certain node types or branches.

methods.name: get_subtree_list
methods.description: Returns a list of nodes in a subtree given a starting node.

methods.name: get_path
methods.description: Returns the path between two nodes in the tree, with options for different formats.

methods.name: get_children
methods.description: Retrieves direct children of a given node.
